nodes.zh: 双面万维网：同时写给人类眼睛与 AI Agent 的出版架构
nodes.en: The Dual-Audience Web: Publishing for Human Eyes and AI Agents

description.zh: 拆解“一文双面”的静态出版范式，内置「人类/Agent 透视实验室」与「瑞士网格字阶实验台」两套零依赖交互装置。
description.en: An architectural blueprint for dual-surface static publishing, complete with a live Human/Agent Representation Inspector and a Swiss Modular Grid Workbench.

nodes.zh: 宁静界面：当交互从点击转向意图
nodes.en: Quiet Interfaces: Designing Beyond the Click

description.zh: 剖析界面过度装饰的根源，并内置「界面信噪比校准器」交互装置，实时对比控件堆砌与克制意图界面之间的视觉熵值。
description.en: An inquiry into chrome fatigue and intent-driven surfaces, complete with a live Interface Noise-to-Signal Calibrator.

nodes.zh: 双语即思考：Agent 时代的写作不再被单一语言围困
nodes.en: Thinking in Stereo: Writing Beyond Monolingual Boundaries

description.zh: 讨论中英双语写作如何反哺逻辑清晰度，并支持在段落左右留白处双击唤醒当前段落的英文对照版本。
description.en: Why maintaining idiomatic Chinese and English editions sharpens thought itself — featuring a margin double-click gesture that unfolds each paragraph's counterpart language in place.

nodes.zh: 十年之后依然可读：静态网页与数字资产的半衰期
nodes.en: Readable in Ten Years: Static HTML and the Half-Life of Digital Work

description.zh: 以数字出版物的半衰期为线索，对比动态栈、重型构建链与零依赖纯静态 HTML 在十年尺度下的维护成本与可迁移性。
description.en: Measuring the half-life of personal publishing stacks across a ten-year horizon, from dynamic CMS databases to zero-dependency static HTML on the edge.

nodes.zh: 后模板时代：为什么个人出版物应该由 Agent 直接书写 HTML
nodes.en: Beyond Templates: Why Personal Publishing Belongs to Agent-Authored HTML

description.zh: 阐述 Tong's Information 的发刊哲学：如何通过秩序层与创意层分离，实现零框架、抗熵增、原生双语的静态出版工作流。
description.en: The founding thesis of Tong's Information: separating structural order from creative layout to achieve a zero-framework, entropy-resistant, agent-bilingual static publication.

description.zh: 将网站同时设计为人类阅读界面与机器可消费的知识协议。
description.en: Designing websites simultaneously as human reading surfaces and machine-consumable knowledge protocols.

description.zh: 剥离多余控件与视觉噪音，让界面回归清晰意图与安静秩序。
description.en: Stripping away decorative chrome and control clutter so interfaces serve human intent quietly.

description.zh: 告别重型构建链与依赖腐烂，回归长期可持续的原生 Web 标准。
description.en: Leaving heavy build chains and dependency rot behind in favor of durable, native web standards.

description.zh: 以数学网格、清晰层级、发丝分割线与克制留白构建理性阅读秩序。
description.en: Building rational reading order through modular grids, typographic hierarchy, hairlines, and negative space.

description.zh: 以单一灵感源稿出发，由 Agent 编辑部产出同等文学与排印品质的双语版本。
description.en: Writing from a single source of thought while an agent editorial desk crafts idiomatic bilingual editions.

description.zh: 用概念拓扑与双向连接取代扁平时间线，沉淀可演进的个人知识网络。
description.en: Replacing flat chronological feeds with conceptual topology and bidirectional links.

description.zh: 基于 Cloudflare Workers Static Assets，保持当下零运维静态，同时预留内容协商与 MCP 接口。
description.en: Hosting on Cloudflare Workers Static Assets for zero-ops static delivery today with seamless upgrades to content negotiation and MCP tomorrow.
